''See also: [[Remnant Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Remnants]] are living forces composed of [[pure madra]] that emerge from the corpses of deceased [[sacred artists]]. They function as spiritual echoes or skeletal sketches of their former physical bodies, often appearing as vivid, colorful outlines rather than detailed beings. While they lack true physical substance and can pass through barriers, they possess varying degrees of intelligence and awareness based on the memories and will of the individual they once were. Because they are fueled by [[madra]], [[Remnants]] can grow in power or intelligence by consuming it, and they eventually dissolve back into essence once their energy is exhausted. These entities exhibit a wide range of behaviors, from being mindless or disoriented at birth to possessing the ability to reason, speak, and negotiate. Their personalities are typically narrow in scope, limited by the fragments of memory they retain from their previous lives. Some [[Remnants]] can be bound or even utilized as resources by [[Soulsmiths]], who may harvest specific [[binding|bindings]] or parts for use in [[constructs]] and weapons. While some [[Remnants]] are predictable, others are wild and unpredictable, capable of anything from offering loyalty to attacking without warning. Highly powerful [[Remnants]], such as those at the [[Herald]] level, appear much more lifelike and robust than lesser spirits.}}

== Unsouled ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|[[Remnants]] are Shadow{{!}}shadow-like constructions of [[pure madra]] that remain after a powerful [[sacred artist]] dies, leaving behind a living force that can be molded by [[Soulsmiths]]. These entities [[hunger]] for human [[madra]], which allows them to develop consciousness and advance in power similarly to humans or [[sacred beasts]]. While they possess only narrow fragments of their former memories, they can manifest in various forms, such as a purple skeletal tree or an ogre-shaped outline made of [[Mountain's Heart]] power. [[Consuming]] a Remnant can provide the necessary strength to transition from [[Jade]] to [[Gold]] rank, though specific types like [[sword]]-aspect [[Remnants]] offer combat advantages at the cost of pursuit capabilities. Some highly potent [[Remnants]], such as a [[Forged madra]] entity from an expert beyond [[Gold]], have even been known to break free from ancient seals and leak silvery motes of essence during combat.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Remnants]] are creatures or objects found within the [[Desolate Wilds|Wilds]] that gather in areas where [[vital aura]] is thick. These entities, which can emerge from walls or peel themselves out of a person's body, often appear as lines of color painted onto the world and can be disoriented upon birth. They gain intelligence and power by consuming human [[madra]], though they can be restricted by [[Script|script]] circles or have their strength devoured by the [[Jai]] spear. While some masters leave behind a Remnant of powerful [[madra]], others are parts of [[sacred beasts]] that are tricky to handle. A [[sacred artist]] must take on the power of a Remnant to advance from [[Jade]] to [[Gold]], and at the [[Gold stage]], one can be held within a core. Examples of these entities include the [[blood madra]] flickering around [[Yerin]]'s waist, the tiny Remnant on Sandviper Kral{{!}}Kral's arm, and various creatures that regularly attack [[Lindon]].}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Composed of solid [[madra]] that resembles a collection of brush-strokes, [[Remnants]] are entities representing a stage of progression higher than an [[Iron]]. These creatures can be dissected with specialized tools or swatted away like flies by those with sufficient power, though they possess dangerous traits such as [[purple madra]] that clings like silk. While some appear as tall, sunken beings with fish-like faces, others manifest as constellations of bright light points forming joints, eyes, and a heart. A Remnant's roar can sound like a bonfire, and they may leave behind techniques or powers for a successor. Though they provide excess energy and can be broken down to digest their skills, they can also be contained within a core through strong suction or held with a death-grip. Certain specimens, such as the one in [[Lindon]]'s pack with [[sapphire]] eyes, possess the ability to cleanse and restore [[madra]].}}

== Underlord ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|[[Remnants]] manifest in diverse and surreal forms, such as a large silver and [[purple book]] featuring a single eye that appeared behind the [[Sage]]. In an underground chamber, a dying Remnant can provide essence, and their corpses may even resemble donkeys fashioned from rainbows that bleed multicolored essence. These entities can also take the shape of a hulking, armored [[giant]] with metallic flesh and a smooth boulder for a face. Additionally, the essence of a Remnant can manifest physically on others, as seen when [[Lindon]] possesses a white Remnant limb.}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Appearing in [[Yerin]]'s classroom as a mute, nightmare-like [[skeleton]], the Remnant serves as a leash for her. These entities are echoes of people from their former lives that gradually consume pieces of themselves to function. Following the death of [[Malice]], a dim purple light signaled the Remnant's rise, during which it beamed at [[Mercy]] to encourage her perseverance. While a Remnant can be integrated into a person's body, this specific being was once a lion that has since taken on a human appearance.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|A [[Remnant]] can be integrated into a person's body.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c29">''Waybound'', chapter 29</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Remnant]] is a being that once was a lion but now looks like a man.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c33">''Waybound'', chapter 33</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|“Good,” Kral said, and the tiny Remnant on his arm bit down.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c13" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|“You're an Iron, not a Remnant; you still need sleep. Food.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c5" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|“Her madra cleanses and restores, I think. She helped me too.”<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c21" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Remnant beamed. “Don’t give up, Mercy! We’ll do this together!”<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26" />}}
